items.mnemonic_text: This radical is a big closed square, like four walls with no door. You walk all the way around and find no way out. It is an <radical form="囗">enclosure</radical>.

items.image_prompt: A tall rocky cliff at the top left leans over, about to fall. Under it, at the bottom right, a big right hand presses up against the rock face, pushing it back the <radical>opposite</radical> way. Small stones fall around the hand.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a very tall man bending under a low shelf. His head bows down, his back curves, and his knees tuck in. He is in a <radical form="𠂊">crouch</radical>.
items.image_prompt: Side view of a very tall man bending under a low wooden bookshelf to grab one coin on the floor. His tipped-down head and neck make the short stroke at the top. His back is the long stroke curving over, then hooking in where his knees tuck tight. He is in a <radical>crouch</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a plain box with a flat roof. Inside, one tired passenger sits on a hard wooden bench. No window, no cushion. This is <radical form="丙">third class</radical>.
items.image_prompt: Cross-section of an old train compartment shaped like a plain box: one flat roof beam across the top, two straight walls down to the floor. Inside, a tired passenger sits on a hard wooden bench, knees apart. Bare bulb, no window, peeling paint: <radical>third class</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a slanted roof with two small marks by the wall. Under the roof, a man shakes so hard that his thermometer snaps in two. This house is full of <radical form="疒">sickness</radical>.
items.description: Both have a dot over a long roof and a wall slanting down on the left. This radical adds two short ticks on the left side of that wall. 广 (cliff / shelter) has no ticks.
items.image_prompt: A small house drawn with a dot on top, a long flat roof, and a wall slanting down on the left, with two short tick marks beside that wall. Under the roof, a pale man in a blanket shivers so hard that the thermometer in his hand snaps in two. The whole room shows <radical>sickness</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two round bumps on a long straight line. A goat is stuck in the dip between the bumps. It cannot go up or down this <radical form="⻖">hill (left)</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A small grassy hill made of two round green bumps stacked one above the other, with one long straight dirt path running down their side. A white goat is stuck nose-first in the dip between the two bumps, legs spread, unable to climb up or down the <radical>hill (left)</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="宀">roof</part> and <part form="元">beginning</part>. A builder holds the plan he drew at the <part form="元">beginning</part>. The house and its <part form="宀">roof</part> match it exactly. It is <radical form="完">perfect</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A newly finished cottage seen from the front, with a straight roof and a centered chimney. Below the roof, the builder leans back on his heels, holding up the paper plan he drew at the beginning. The house matches the plan line for line: <radical>perfect</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="宀">roof</part> and <part form="口">mouth</part>. Under the <part form="宀">roof</part> of an office, a clerk stamps form after form. His <part form="口">mouth</part> opens only to shout "Next!" He is a <radical form="官">bureaucrat</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A government office with a peaked roof on top. Under the roof, a small clerk sits at a desk buried in paper, thumping a red rubber stamp onto a stream of forms. His mouth is wide open, shouting "Next!" at a long line of people. Flat muted colors: one busy <radical>bureaucrat</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical is made of <part form="宀">roof</part> and <part form="八">split</part>. The rock under a stone <part form="宀">roof</part> is <part form="八">split</part> open. Behind the gap is a dark <radical form="穴">cave</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A rocky hillside. At the top, a flat stone ledge sticks out like a small roof. Under it, the rock splits open into two sides slanting apart, making a wide dark opening. Inside is the black mouth of a <radical>cave</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="日">sun</part> and <part form="丨">stick</part>. A sprout, thin as a <part form="丨">stick</part>, grows out of a box. Inside the box shines a small <part form="日">sun</part>. The <part form="日">sun</part> is the <radical form="由">reason</radical> it grows.
items.image_prompt: A closed wooden crate on a shelf. One thin sprout, straight as a stick, rises out of the top of the crate. The crate is cracked open at the front, and inside a small bright sun glows, lighting up the sprout. The sun is the <radical>reason</radical> the plant grows.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a dart coming down onto the flat ground at the bottom. It sticks point-first in the floor, still shaking. Watch it <radical form="至">arrive</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A dart flies across a room in a slow arc and turns nose-down. Its point sticks into a flat wooden floor, and it stands upright, still shaking. Small motion lines trace the path it took to finally <radical>arrive</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a person lying face down with one leg kicked out. He fell asleep on the floor at a party hours ago. The guests step around the <radical form="尸">body</radical>.
items.description: 戸 (door) is the same shape with one extra short stroke lying across the top. 广 (cliff / shelter) has a dot on top and only a roof line with a wall under it; it has no closed box.
items.image_prompt: A party in a Japanese room with tatami floor. A man lies face down on the tatami, bent over, one leg kicked out to the side. He has not moved for hours. Guests in party clothes carefully step around the sprawled <radical>body</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a handful of rice thrown into the air. The grains fly off in every direction and land far apart. Each grain is <radical form="釆">separate</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A hand has just thrown a handful of rice into the air. The grains fly out in many directions, each on its own path, and land far apart on a wooden floor. No two grains touch; every one is <radical>separate</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a wax seal pressed onto a letter, with a long hooked tail of wax behind it. The seal leaves one mark: your <radical form="氏">family name</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A hand presses an ornate wax seal with a tilted handle onto a paper letter. A long hooked ribbon of red wax trails out behind it. On the paper, the seal leaves one clear mark: the <radical>family name</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a small spool at the top with one strand twisting down. At the bottom, the loose ends spread out. It is one piece of <radical form="糸">thread</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A small wooden spool at the top. One strand winds off it and twists down in two loops. At the bottom, the end frays into three loose fibers spread apart. Plain background, one piece of <radical>thread</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="目">eye</part>, <part form="一">ground</part> and <part form="八">split</part>. An <part form="目">eye</part> looks through a telescope. It stands on the <part form="一">ground</part> on legs <part form="八">split</part> wide apart. It is a useful <radical form="具">tool</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A telescope with a big eye looking through it at the top. It sits on a flat bar on the ground, held up by two legs split wide apart. The eye stays steady and the hands stay free. A handy <radical>tool</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a fat box with a line through it and a small stroke at the corner. The box is a plump body on a pin. The stroke is a leg that still twitches. It is an <radical form="虫">insect</radical>.
items.image_prompt: Inside a collector's display case: a fat box-shaped body with a vertical pin through it. A small stroke sticks out from the bottom right corner, a leg still twitching. One pinned <radical>insect</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical has a flat top, a straight leg on the left, and a right leg that bends out at the foot. It is a small <radical form="几">table</radical>. It leans so much that the teacup slides off.
items.image_prompt: A low side table seen from the front. The top is one short flat stroke. The left leg falls straight to the floor. The right leg comes across, then bends down and out into a small foot. The table leans, and a teacup slides off it mid-fall. One wobbling <radical>table</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="千">thousand</part> and <part form="里">village</part>. A <part form="千">thousand</part> sacks of rice are piled on top of a small <part form="里">village</part>. The houses sink into the ground. The load is <radical form="重">heavy</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A small village of wooden houses and rice fields. On top of it sits a huge tower of a thousand rice sacks. The houses are sinking into the ground under the weight, and the villagers stare up in shock. Everything is <radical>heavy</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical is two short strokes, one above the other. They are two chips of frost that a scraper pulls off a car window. Both are hard <radical form="冫">ice</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A hand drags a scraper across a frosty car windshield. Two curls of frost come off, a short one above and a longer hooked one below, and they hang in the air, frozen solid as two chunks of <radical>ice</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="小">small</part> and <part form="丿">slash</part>. Many <part form="小">small</part> crumbs sit on a counter. One <part form="丿">slash</part> of a broom sweeps most of them off. Only a <radical form="少">few</radical> are left.
items.image_prompt: Side view of a kitchen counter. On top, three small crumbs remain. Below them, one long broom stroke slashes from upper right to lower left, sending a stream of crumbs off the edge. A hand holds the broom mid-sweep. Only a <radical>few</radical> crumbs remain.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a person squeezing out from under a heavy lid, head bent, legs kicking. Everyone else stays stuck under it. This one walks away free. He is <radical form="免">exempt</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A heavy lid presses down on a crowd of people. One person squeezes out from under it: head bent, body pressed thin, two legs kicking free at the bottom. The others are still stuck under the lid. This one walks off, <radical>exempt</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical puts a <part form="亠">lid</part> on top of a <part form="王">king</part>. The <part form="王">king</part> wears a pot <part form="亠">lid</part> as a hat. Nobody laughs. He is still the <radical form="主">lord</radical> of the house.
items.image_prompt: A king in a red robe sits on a throne in a grand hall, wearing a round metal pot lid on his head instead of a crown. Servants bow low in front of him with serious faces. He is still the <radical>lord</radical> of the house.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a signpost at a crossroads, with a lid on top and one arm that swings out and hooks to the side. The arm points the way. It shows you a <radical form="方">direction</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A wooden signpost at a crossroads. A flat board lies across the top like a lid. Below, the post has a crossbar and one long arm that swings out and hooks hard to one side, pointing down a road. A traveler stops and looks where it points: a <radical>direction</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a head lying flat on an open book, with two short legs hanging off the bottom. Someone fell asleep while reading. Their <radical form="頁">head</radical> is stuck to the page.
items.image_prompt: An open notebook on a desk. A person has fallen asleep reading: their wide face lies flat on the paper, one cheek squashed, and two short legs dangle off the bottom edge of the page. The sleeping <radical>head</radical> fills the page.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="日">sun</part> and <part form="疋">head</part>. At noon the <part form="日">sun</part> is straight above a man's <part form="疋">head</part>. He sets his watch to twelve. Now the time is <radical form="是">right</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A sunny town square at noon. The sun hangs straight above a man's head, so he has no shadow. He looks up, then turns the hands of his pocket watch to twelve with a proud smile. The time is exactly <radical>right</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="白">white</part>, <part form="冫">ice</part> and <part form="木">tree</part>. A <part form="白">white</part> drum hangs in a <part form="木">tree</part> with <part form="冫">ice</part> on each side. When the wind blows, the <part form="冫">ice</part> taps the drum and makes <radical form="楽">music</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A tree in winter. A small white drum hangs from its top branches. On each side of the drum hangs a short piece of ice. The wind blows, the ice pieces swing and tap the drum, and little notes float into the air: <radical>music</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two flat puffs stacked one on top of the other, with a small curl under the lower one. Nothing holds them up. They just float. It is a <radical form="云">cloud</radical>.
items.image_prompt: Two flat-bottomed white puffs stacked one above the other, wider than they are tall, floating in a blue sky. A small wisp curls out from under the lower puff. No post, no string holds it up. One drifting <radical>cloud</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a snake curled up tight in a box, with its head poking out of a gap at the top. You open the box, and it is already there: a <radical form="巳">snake</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A small open wooden box. Inside, a snake is curled up tight, its body looping around the box. Its head pokes up through a small gap at the top corner, looking at you. A calm, waiting <radical>snake</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a wide open mouth with a flat tongue across the middle. The tongue is moving, pushing out a word. The mouth is about to <radical form="曰">say</radical> something.
items.description: 曰 and 日 are the same box with one bar inside, told apart by proportion. 曰 is squat, wider than it is tall, and its inner bar often stops short of the right wall. 日 is clearly taller than it is wide.
items.image_prompt: A wide, squat open mouth seen from the front, wider than it is tall. One flat tongue lies across the middle, moving mid-word. A small speech bubble starts to come out. The mouth is about to <radical>say</radical> something.

items.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a broom head turned on its side. The line on the right is where the handle goes. The three lines are the bristles. It is a <radical form="ヨ">broom</radical>.
items.image_prompt: A broom head turned on its side. The upright on the right is the wooden back where the handle goes in. Three stiff grey bristle rows stick out to the left, dusty from a very long hallway. A well-used <radical>broom</radical>.
